name: Morocco (Al Haouz) Mw6.8 earthquake, Sep 2023
description: Impact Forecasting Morocco Earthquake Model - part of the regional Maghreb earthquake model. Three footprints are provided for the event: one based on the United States Geological Survey (USGS) shakemap and two based on Global Earthquake Model (GEM) fault parameters.

vulnerability.source: Impact Forecasting damage functions, supplied with the Morocco earthquake scenario
vulnerability.description: Damage functions by occupancy (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural) and coverage (buildings, contents and business interruption). Construction type is not used.
